areaCorrected: The area was corrected by hand.
cannotCreate: Your account can view data but not add projects. Ask your supervisor if you need to enter data.
cannotEdit: Only the person who entered this project or a reviewer can change it.
capacityHint: Approximate number of worshippers or students it holds.
discardEditBody: The project stays as it was before you opened the form.
discardNewBody: Everything entered in this form, including its photos, will be removed from this device.
draftDiscardBody: “{name}” and everything entered in it will be removed from this device.
dupIntro: These projects look like the one you are entering. Is it one of them?
dupSimilarName: similar name in the same village
errAreaRequired: Choose the area (at least the region).
errBuildDateYear: The date does not match the year built.
errBuildYear: Enter a valid year (from 1800 to this year).
errDonorRequired: Choose a donor or add a new one.
errEndBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
errLocalityName: Type the name of the new locality.
errLocationRequired: Capture the location (GPS or map) before submitting for review.
errNonNegative: Enter zero or a positive number.
errNonNegativeInt: Enter zero or a positive whole number.
errTooLong: The text is too long (200 characters at most).
geofillBusy: Finding the country and area from the location…
geofillDone: The country and area were filled from the location. You can correct them.
geoOutsideArea: The point is outside the chosen area. Check the location or the area.
geoOutsideCountry: The point is outside the chosen country. Check the location or the country.
gpsDenied: Location access is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings, or pick the point on the map.
gpsTimeout: No GPS signal. Move to an open place and try again, or pick the point on the map.
gpsUnavailable: The location is not available right now. Try again or pick the point on the map.
gpsUnsupported: This device cannot give a GPS location. Pick the point on the map.
gpsWeak: weaker than {limit} m; move to an open place and capture again
inReview: This record is waiting for review; your changes keep it in review.
keptAsDraft: Your entry was kept in the unfinished entries.
leaveBody: What you entered stays on this device as an unfinished entry; you can continue later.
localityHint: Choose from the list or add a new name.
localityNewHint: The new name is proposed to your supervisor for approval.
locationHint: Stand at the project and capture the GPS location, or pick it on the map.
maintDiscardBody: The maintenance entry you typed will be lost.
maintIntro: Describe what needs repair; the entry appears in the maintenance list.
maintMissing: Add a maintenance entry that describes what needs repair.
mapUnavailable: The map is not available on this device yet. Type the coordinates or use GPS.
nameArHint: As people know it, preferably in Arabic.
nameLatinHint: Optional — helps searching in Swahili and English.
notOnDevice: This project is not on this device. Sync, then try again.
photosBusy: Wait until the photos are ready.
photosUnavailable: Photos cannot be added on this device yet.
possibleMatches: Possible matching people — choose one, or add a new person
removeBody: This entry is removed from the project when you save.
restoreBody: Changes you made to this project earlier were kept on this device but not saved. Restore them?
resumeBody: “{name}” was not finished and is still kept on this device. Continue it? If you start a new project instead, it stays in the list of unfinished entries.
returnsToReview: This record is approved. Saving your changes sends it back for review.
salaryNoteBlind: Restricted: salaries are never shown on this device. What you enter goes to management and replaces the salary from the same date.
salaryNoteReader: Restricted data: every access is logged.
saved: Saved on this device — it is uploaded when the connection is back
saveFailed: The project could not be saved. Your entry is kept; try again.
saveGone: This project is no longer on this device (deleted or moved). Your entry is kept as a draft.
sensitiveNoteBlind: Restricted: stored values are not shown on this device. Fill in only what you know; filled values replace earlier ones.
sensitiveNoteReader: Restricted data: every access is logged.
serverRejected: The server did not accept some earlier changes to this project. Correct the marked fields and save again.
srvDonorUnavailable: This donor is not available to you.
srvLocalityCountry: The locality belongs to another country.
srvOptionValue: One of the chosen options is no longer valid.
srvOutOfScope: The project is outside your branch or country.
srvPersonUnavailable: This person is not available to you.
srvPhotoLimit: A project can have at most 10 photos.
srvTransition: The review state could not be changed this way.
statusHint: Choosing “needs maintenance” opens a maintenance entry.
